issues.description: Missing input validation - query parameter is not validated before use. If query is null, undefined, or not a string, the indexOf() call will throw a TypeError causing application crashes
issues.suggestion: Add input validation at function start: if (!query || typeof query !== 'string') { return []; }

issues.description: Case-sensitive search using indexOf() may not meet user expectations. Searching for 'Buy' won't match 'buy milk'
issues.suggestion: Convert both strings to lowercase for case-insensitive search: todo.text.toLowerCase().indexOf(query.toLowerCase()) !== -1

issues.description: Using var instead of const/let is outdated ES5 syntax with function-scoping issues
issues.suggestion: Replace var with const for immutable values and let for loop variables

issues.description: Using traditional for-loops instead of modern array methods makes code less readable and potentially less performant
issues.suggestion: Use filter() method: return listTodos().filter(todo => todo.text.includes(query));

issues.description: Using indexOf() is older syntax. Modern JavaScript uses includes() which is more readable
Code duplication between searchTodos and searchTodosByStatus functions. Changes to search behavior require updates in multiple places
issues.suggestion: Refactor to reuse base search: export function searchTodosByStatus(query, done) { return searchTodos(query).filter(todo => todo.done === done); }

issues.description: Functions lack JSDoc documentation describing parameters, return values, and behavior
issues.suggestion: Add JSDoc comments with @param and @returns tags

issues.description: The done parameter uses strict equality (===) with boolean but no validation ensures it's actually a boolean. Non-boolean values will cause silent failures
issues.suggestion: Add type validation: if (typeof done !== 'boolean') { throw new TypeError('done must be a boolean'); }

codeQuality.summary: The new search functionality introduces critical security vulnerabilities due to missing input validation that could cause application crashes. The code uses outdated JavaScript patterns (var, indexOf, traditional for-loops) and lacks proper error handling. Code duplication between the two search functions creates maintainability issues. Priority actions: add input validation, implement modern JavaScript patterns, and eliminate code duplication.

untestedPaths.reasoning: No tests verify behavior with special characters, regex metacharacters, or Unicode

testCoverage.summary: src/search.js has ZERO test coverage. Both exported functions are completely untested. Critical gaps include: no validation of edge cases (empty/null queries), no verification of case-sensitive search behavior, no testing of boolean parameter handling. Priority: Create tests/search.test.js with minimum 15-20 test cases covering happy paths, edge cases, and error conditions.

suggestions.description: Replace outdated var declarations with const and let for better scoping, immutability, and modern JavaScript practices
suggestions.benefits: Block scoping prevents variable leakage, const makes immutability explicit reducing bugs, aligns with modern JavaScript best practices

suggestions.description: Replace imperative for-loops with functional array methods (filter) for more declarative, readable code
suggestions.benefits: Reduces code from 8 lines to 1 line, eliminates mutable state, more declarative and easier to understand, less prone to errors

suggestions.description: Replace indexOf with modern includes() method for better readability when checking string presence
suggestions.benefits: More expressive intent, reduces cognitive load, modern JavaScript standard (ES2015+), improves readability

suggestions.description: Extract common text-matching logic to eliminate code duplication between searchTodos and searchTodosByStatus
suggestions.benefits: Eliminates code duplication (DRY principle), single source of truth for search matching, easier to modify search behavior, improved testability

suggestions.description: Simplify the nested conditional logic by combining filter conditions with logical AND operator
suggestions.benefits: Reduces nesting depth from 3 levels to 1, improves readability, eliminates temporary variables, reduces cognitive complexity

refactorings.summary: src/search.js has 5 major refactoring opportunities focusing on modernizing from ES5 to ES6+ syntax (var to const/let, for-loops to filter, indexOf to includes), eliminating code duplication between the two search functions, and reducing complexity through functional programming patterns. The most critical refactorings are modernizing with filter methods and extracting duplicate search logic.

issues.description: Missing input validation on query parameter - req.query.q is passed directly to searchTodos() without validation. If query parameter is missing, undefined will be passed causing application crash
issues.suggestion: Add validation before calling searchTodos: if (!query || typeof query !== 'string') { return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Query parameter "q" is required' }); }

issues.description: No query parameter sanitization - no length limit on query parameter. Extremely long queries could cause performance issues or DoS attacks
issues.suggestion: Add length validation: if (query.length > 1000) { return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Query too long' }); }

issues.description: Missing error handling - if searchTodos() throws an error, it will crash the server. No try-catch block or error handling middleware
issues.suggestion: Add try-catch: try { res.json(searchTodos(query)); } catch (error) { console.error('Search error:', error); res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' }); }

issues.description: Potential performance issue with large datasets - search endpoint returns all matching results without pagination. Could cause memory and performance issues
issues.suggestion: Implement pagination with limit and offset query parameters

issues.description: Missing rate limiting - search endpoints are often targets for abuse. No rate limiting is implemented, allowing unlimited search requests
issues.suggestion: Implement rate limiting middleware using express-rate-limit

issues.description: No request logging - search requests aren't logged, making debugging and monitoring difficult
issues.suggestion: Add logging middleware or log search queries for analytics

Most critical refactorings are extracting route handlers for testability and adding input validation for the search endpoint.

recommendations.description: Add input validation to prevent application crashes. Both src/search.js and src/server.js lack validation for null/undefined/invalid query parameters, which will cause TypeError exceptions and crash the application.

Add comprehensive test coverage for new search functionality. Currently 0% test coverage for both src/search.js and the new /todos/search endpoint. Create tests/search.test.js and add integration tests to verify functionality and prevent regressions.

Implement error handling in the /todos/search endpoint. Add try-catch blocks to prevent unhandled exceptions from crashing the server. Return appropriate HTTP status codes (400 for validation errors, 500 for server errors).

Refactor search functions to use modern JavaScript (ES6+). Replace var with const/let, use filter() instead of for-loops, and use includes() instead of indexOf(). This will improve readability, maintainability, and reduce bug risk.
Eliminate code duplication in search.js. The searchTodos and searchTodosByStatus functions contain duplicate search logic. Refactor searchTodosByStatus to call searchTodos to follow DRY principle.

Implement case-insensitive search. Current implementation uses indexOf() which is case-sensitive, likely not matching user expectations. Convert both query and todo text to lowercase before comparison.
Add rate limiting to the /todos/search endpoint. Search endpoints are common targets for abuse. Implement rate limiting middleware (e.g., express-rate-limit) to prevent DoS attacks.
Consider adding pagination to search results. Without pagination, large result sets could cause memory and performance issues. Add limit and offset query parameters to control result size.
Extract route handlers into named functions. This will improve testability, code organization, and make debugging easier with better stack traces.
Add JSDoc documentation to search functions. Document parameters, return values, and expected behavior to improve code maintainability and developer experience.
